name: yourIntelligent
shortDescription: A revision partner for student reflections: choose a passage, get one observation and one question, and write the revision yourself. Bring your own Gemini API key.
detailedDescription:
Start with your words.

yourIntelligent is a Google Docs revision partner for university students writing personal essays and course reflections. Choose a passage and a focus, receive one AI observation and one question, and decide what to revise yourself.

How it works
• Capture selected plain text and review the exact local preview.
• Choose clarity, depth, voice, or your own focus. Add course context only if you want to.
• Explicitly ask Gemini for a reading.
• Keep, reject, redirect or skip the feedback. Write your revision directly in Docs.
• Refresh the selected passage locally, then ask for another reading when ready. The next request assesses only the refreshed passage.

Your choices stay with you
You do not have to answer the AI or accept its suggestion to continue. The app exposes no operation to insert or replace document text. AI feedback can be mistaken; you decide what to use and remain responsible for following your course rules.

Key and data handling
Bring your own Gemini API key. The app has no subscription; provider charges and quota limits may apply to your account. The key is held only in sidebar-session memory. An explicit reading sends the captured passage, chosen focus and any added context through Apps Script to Gemini. No prior draft is sent for a second reading. The app does not persist keys, writing or feedback; it retains bounded request-ID/timestamp metadata to prevent duplicate submissions. Provider processing is separate. Unpaid Gemini services may use content for improvement and human review; review provider terms and avoid sensitive content.

Try sample uses visibly prepared feedback without a live API request.

Publisher: John Phillip Custodio. Independent project; no Google or university affiliation is implied. For help and privacy details, use the support and policy links.
